title: Restriction of sheaf scalar extension is tensor by the target ring
statement: On an essentially small site $J$, let $A,B$ be commutative rings in the module universe, and $f:A\to B$ a ring map. With scalar extension $E_f$ from [def-pur-finite-reduction-system] and exact scalar restriction $U_f$, there is a natural isomorphism $E_f U_f\cong -\otimes_A\underline{U_f B}$, where the composition means first extension and then restriction, and $\underline{U_f B}$ is the constant sheaf associated to the $A$-module $B$. No flatness or surjectivity of $f$ is assumed.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: Use ModuleCat.extendScalarsCompRestrictScalarsIso on presheaves. Restriction has a right adjoint (coextension), so preserves sheafification. The whiskering tensor comparison and the sheafification counit identify the sheafified constant coefficient with the stated constant sheaf; compose these natural isomorphisms.
